listing.name: Crown Constellation 0.2.0b
listing.summary: The Crown Constellation is a place of greivous conflict between the isolationist, potentially AI-worshipping Holy Covenant of Kemet and the aggressive, low-tech, Ludd-aligned Taj Star Unity. While these two polities fight, pirates and pathers slip underneath their notice, using their conflict to obscure their activities.

description:
The Crown Constellation is a place of greivous conflict between the isolationist, potentially AI-worshipping Holy Covenant of Kemet and the aggressive, low-tech, Ludd-aligned Taj Star Unity. While these two polities fight, pirates and pathers slip underneath their notice, using their conflict to obscure their activities.

```
-Name changed from Holy Covenant of Kemet to Crown Constellation

-Introducing the Taj Star Unity, a Ludd-aligned faction with LIDAR ships, mech fighters, magnetically-accelerated cannons and composite rocket weaponry.
-Holy Covenant of Kemet and Taj Star Unity now live in the Crown Constellation, a place which is often quite dangerous to approach. Be sure to check the Crown Situation in Intel tab to check what may face you moving through the area.
-Lots of teeny tiny fixes to Holy Covenant of Kemet.
-Has several fixes when compared with pre-release version, namely trying to fix the killfleets to work properly.

QUICK FIX
-Properly hid the Kemet 'Killfleet' faction

QUICK FIX 2
-Capitalization fix for linux users.
```

```NOT Savegame compatible.```

Download:https://bitbucket.org/King_Alfonzo/i-will-make-sindria-great-again/downloads/Crown_Constellation_0_2_0b.zip
